history.body: Hi, I saw the listing. We’re looking for a bit more room for the family. Is the living area comfortable for everyday family use?

For family use, the Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor, so the shared space isn’t broken up by a lengthy hallway. Whether it feels comfortable will depend on your family’s needs and furniture, but a viewing would let you judge the proportions in person. Happy to arrange one if you’d like.
That sounds promising, but I’m trying to picture it with the kids and a dining table. Do you have a floor plan you can share?

I don’t have the floor-plan image to attach here, so I’ll check for the approved Type A plan. What I can confirm is that the entrance foyer leads into an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, with three bedrooms and a small storage area. I wouldn’t want to guess how a particular dining table fits without the plan—exact furniture fit should be checked against it.

Thanks for checking instead of guessing. The open layout sounds useful with the kids, but my partner would prefer to see the layout first before we arrange a viewing. I’ll check with them and get back to you.

Of course—it makes sense for you both to see the approved layout first, especially to judge the dining-table fit. I’ll share it if it’s confirmed available; then you can decide together whether a viewing would be useful.
